source: Owner-requested ten-channel PM reconciliation; completed baselines excluded and existing applications retained.

upstream.scopeObserved: Public GitHub server source that users can install and run. Hosted-only URLs are directed to the separate awesome-remote-mcp-servers repository.
upstream.formatObserved: One concise server line, repository link, relevant category and alphabetical placement; the contribution guide offers a documented automated-agent review title option.

deduplication.limits: These current README and focused PR checks do not exhaust every possible alias or issue. Repeat the final dedup check immediately before contributing.

eligibility.nextStep: Establish that the existing supported full-stack self-hosting route satisfies the current installable-source requirement, then prepare one accurate entry. Do not invent a standalone package or deploy a second stack merely for listing QA.

boundary: This pass arranges the work and records public primary-source scope/dedup evidence. It does not claim main-list eligibility approval, submission, merge, live installation, current traffic/star metrics, or refreshed status for the other channels.
